about.title: A New Chapter for Coconut
about.subtitle: Discover who we are — a young Indonesian producer backed by decades of group expertise.
about.companyIntroBody: PT. Prima Coco Indonusa is a coconut product manufacturer based in Indonesia, part of Huanlejia Food Group (300997.SZ). We focus on producing premium coconut ingredients — coconut water, coconut milk & cream, desiccated coconut and virgin coconut oil — for global B2B customers in food, beverage and personal care industries.
about.groupBody: Huanlejia Food Group is a leading Chinese food manufacturer listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (Stock Code: 300997). With decades of expertise in canned food and beverage, the group has built a multi-category portfolio and is expanding its global footprint with operations across China, Vietnam, Thailand and Indonesia.
about.indonesiaBody: Established as the group's coconut production hub in Indonesia, PT. Prima Coco Indonusa leverages local agricultural resources and modern processing lines to serve customers worldwide. We combine Indonesian raw material advantages with the group's quality systems and international sales experience.

factory.title: Inside Our Facility
factory.subtitle: Modern processing lines, strict quality control, and a deep respect for raw materials.
factory.intro: Our production facility is located in Kabupaten Langkat, Sumatera Utara, Indonesia. It brings together modern processing technology with strict food-safety management. Every batch is traceable from raw material to finished product.
